learningObjectives: Distinguish entropy, entropy derivatives, mutual information, conditional mutual information, Crofton density, and bulk length.
Compute conditional mutual information from four entropy terms.
Explain how mixed endpoint derivatives produce a local kinematic density in the cited construction.
State the holographic, semiclassical, regulator, and state assumptions needed for geometric interpretation.
definitions: Entanglement entropy: the von Neumann entropy of a subsystem's reduced state.
Entropy Hessian: the matrix or form of second derivatives of entropy with respect to interval parameters.
Kinematic density: the local form on interval space derived from endpoint variations of entropy in the cited setting.
Holographic entropy surface: the minimal or extremal bulk surface associated with a boundary region under an applicable prescription.
Crofton reconstruction: recovery of a geometric measure by integrating over a family of intersecting probes.
notebookPrompt: Create a rigorous cinematic lesson titled ‘Information, entropy, and kinematic geometry.’ Display an interval entropy function S(u,v) over endpoint space, take its mixed endpoint derivative to produce a local kinematic density, and build the finite-difference combination I(A:C|B)=S(AB)+S(BC)-S(B)-S(ABC). Tile these local contributions over the geodesics intersecting a bulk curve and show the Crofton integral reconstructing length only under the cited AdS3/CFT2 assumptions. Explicitly separate entropy, entropy derivative, conditional mutual information, measure, and length with persistent labels. Contrast the static Ryu–Takayanagi minimal surface with the covariant HRT extremal surface without claiming they apply universally. Include regulator, state, semiclassical, and correction limits, and reject ‘more entropy always means more distance.’
humanFrame: Present a chain of typed maps, not a mystical equivalence between information and geometry. If a hypothesis disappears, visually interrupt the corresponding arrow.
assessment: Calculate one conditional mutual information value from supplied entropies, identify the derivative represented by a small endpoint rectangle, and list the hypotheses needed before interpreting the result geometrically.
